entities.name: Query RALF-like peptide
observations: 72 aa precursor; calculated molecular weight 7,882.074 Da, theoretical pI 8.614, and charge at pH 7 of +2.54.
Exact sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana Protein RALF-like 11 (UniProt O64466).
Contains an N-terminal signal peptide at residues 1–17 and a mature chain annotated at residues 18–72.
Pfam RALF domain detected at residues 10–71 with i-Evalue 5.7e-17.
Predicted/annotated disulfide bonds occur within the mature peptide, including residue pairs 34–43 and 63–69 in the matching reference.

entities.name: Arabidopsis RALF-like 11
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference O64466; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated as a secreted cell-signaling peptide involved in plant stress, growth, and development.
Reported to promote rapid extracellular alkalinization through transient cytoplasmic Ca2+ increase, calcium-dependent signaling, and activation of some MAP kinases.

entities.name: Arabidopsis RALF-like 12
observations: Reviewed reference F4ISE1 shares 94.4% identity with full query coverage and is annotated as a secreted RALF signaling peptide.
